verdict.rationale: mise documents a dedicated lockfile (mise-lock.html) with `mise install --locked` and `mise lock --bump` commands for reproducible installs, and its config/lockfiles (mise.toml, mise.lock) are plain text and git-committed, which is diff-friendly by nature of the CLI's file-based design. However, the evidence never explicitly states the lockfile's text format or shows an example lockfile, nor does it call out lockfile diffability for AI-agent consumption specifically. missing for 10: an explicit example/schema of the lockfile contents, explicit confirmation of its text/TOML format, and any agent-specific guidance on reading/diffing it.
